title: VncSharpCore
author: zgabi
body_snippet:
Could you please release a new nuget package of the VncSharpCore project?
Version 1.2.1 has a serious issue, a cursor file is missing from the assembly.

See: https://github.com/mRemoteNG/mRemoteNG/issues/2321
The cursor file was added back long time ago (25th Sept, 2023), but there was no new package released.
